title: Scientific narrative and public expert context
summary: Prepared from the bundled Ibrance evidence for the no-key demo run.

claims.text: Palbociclib inhibits CDK4 and CDK6 and blocks progression from G1 into S phase in ER-positive breast cancer cell lines.

In PALOMA-2, investigator-assessed median progression-free survival was 24.8 months with IBRANCE plus letrozole and 14.5 months with placebo plus letrozole; overall survival was not statistically significant in the prespecified final analysis.
